name: MAT309H1 — Socratic Discovery (Predicate Calculus and Formal Languages)
description: Language: variables, connectives (∧∨¬→), quantifiers (∀∃), =, predicate symbols (P,Q...), function symbols (f,g...). Terms = variables + functions app

steps.template_en: Language: variables, connectives (∧∨¬→), quantifiers (∀∃), =, predicate symbols (P,Q...), function symbols (f,g...). Terms = variables + functions applied to terms. Formulas = atomic formulas closed under connectives and quantifiers.
steps.template_zh: 语言：变量、连接词(∧∨¬→)、量词(∀∃)、=、谓词符号(P,Q...)、函数符号(f,g...)。项=变量+函数应用于项。公式=原子公式在连接词和量词下封闭。

steps.template_en: What is a STRUCTURE? A set M (domain) with: for each n-ary P, P^M⊆Mⁿ; for each n-ary f, f^M:Mⁿ→M. Truth defined recursively (Tarski's definition).
steps.template_zh: 什么是结构？集合M(论域)。每个n元P: P^M⊆Mⁿ；每个n元f: f^M:Mⁿ→M。真值递归定义(Tarski真值定义)。

steps.template_en: A sentence is valid (⊨φ) if true in EVERY structure. ∀x(x=x) valid. ∀xP(x)→∃xP(x) NOT valid (empty domain counterexample). Completeness Theorem: validity = provability.
steps.template_zh: 语句有效(⊨φ)若在每个结构真。∀x(x=x)有效。∀xP(x)→∃xP(x)无效(空域反例)。完备定理：有效性=可证性。

steps.template_en: Syntactic deduction: ⊢φ provable from axioms using inference rules. Natural deduction: (∧I) from φ,ψ infer φ∧ψ. (∀I) if x not free, from φ infer ∀xφ. (∃E) from ∃xφ, assuming φ(t), infer ψ.
steps.template_zh: 语法推演：⊢φ从公理用推理规则可证。自然演绎：(∧I)从φ,ψ推出φ∧ψ。(∀I)若x不自由，从φ推出∀xφ。(∃E)从∃xφ并假设φ(t)推出ψ。

steps.template_en: Translate: (1) Every positive integer has a unique prime factorization. (2) Between any two distinct reals there's another. (3) No largest prime. (4) Function continuous at a point (ε-δ).
steps.template_zh: 翻译：(1)每个正整数有唯一素因子分解。(2)任意两不同实数间有另一实数。(3)无最大素数。(4)函数在一点连续(ε-δ)。

steps.template_en: Predicate logic: expressive enough for most mathematics, yet COMPLETE proof system. Gödel's Completeness: SEMANTIC (truth in all structures) = SYNTACTIC (provability). Remarkable!
steps.template_zh: 谓词逻辑：表达足够多数学，却有完备证明系统。Gödel完备：语义(所有结构真)=语法(可证性)。了不起！
